Let's load the document that we will be working with:

```{r}

library(readxl)

usdata <- read_xlsx("C:/Users/artem/Desktop/R/Programación R/US Statistics.xlsx")

# Change the location of the document by YOUR location of the document using CTRL C + CTRL V

usdata <- as.data.frame(usdata)

```


### TWO VARIABLES (ONE ON X-AXIS, ONE ON Y-AXIS)


Let us proceed in a step by step manner doing the data visualization in `ggplot2`, which forms part of the Tidyverse:

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

ggplot(data = usdata,
       mapping = aes(x = Year, y = `Unadjusted Business Profits`)) +
       geom_bar(stat = "identity")

```

Let us add colour to see the distinction between the columns:

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

ggplot(data = usdata,
       mapping = aes(x = factor(Year), y = `Unadjusted Business Profits`,
                     #factor(Year) allows us to derive a sequence in scale_x_discrete()
                     fill = `Unadjusted Business Profits`)) + #add this for colour
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggtitle("Unadjusted Business Profits in the US Economy (1929 - 1963)") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1929, 1962, 5)) + #years in sequence of 5
  scale_colour_gradient() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Amount (Billion of Dollars)") +
  theme_minimal()

```

### THREE (OR MORE) VARIABLES (ONE ON X-AXIS, TWO OR MORE ON Y-AXIS)

If we wish to have a representation of two or more variables, we have to perform a tiny proceeding first - using, in this case, `pivot_longer()`:

```{r}

usdata_longformat = usdata |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Unadjusted Business Profits`, `Unadjusted Depreciation Estimates`),
    names_to = "Component",
    values_to = "Value")

```

Let us now proceed with the data visualization, using "Component" and "Value" as our reference variables:

```{r}

ggplot(data = usdata_longformat,
       mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")

```

Let us proceed to do a more complete visualization:

```{r}

ggplot(usdata_longformat, 
       mapping = aes(x = factor(Year), y = Value, fill = Component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(levels(factor(usdata_longformat$Year)) == 1946), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 18, y = 74, label = "Post World War II (1946 - 1962)"), colour = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1929, 1962, 5)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", 
                   name = "Economic Surplus (Unadjusted)",
                   labels = c("Business Profits", "Depreciation Estimates")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Amount (Billion of Dollars)") +
  theme_minimal()

```
